terra.problem: The third moment says the people sent the ark to Kiriath-jearim, but 1 Samuel 6:21 says they sent messengers asking its people to come and take it. The ark is taken in 1 Samuel 7:1.
For a 5th-grade reading level, replace “priestly city” with “city for priests” and “Judah was routed” with “Judah was defeated.”
